title: Retail Sales Assistant
description: Ask questions about retail sales, products, stores, customers, returns and service cases.
sample_questions: What were total net revenue and units sold yesterday?
Top 10 products by gross margin in the last 30 days
Which region has the highest return rate this month?
Compare online vs store revenue by week for the last 8 weeks
instructions: Use gold.obt_retail_sales for almost all questions; it is one row per order line.
Revenue means net_revenue (line_amount minus refunds) unless the user says 'gross' or 'sales before returns'.
Exclude rows where status = 'CANCELLED' from revenue and units unless asked.
Weeks start on Monday. 'Yesterday' is current_date() - 1 on order_date.
loyalty_tier_at_purchase is the customer's tier when the order was placed (SCD2); current tier lives in gold.dim_customer where __END_AT IS NULL.

benchmarks.question: What was total net revenue in the last 7 days?
benchmarks.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(net_revenue),2) AS net_revenue FROM {catalog}.gold.obt_retail_sales WHERE status <> 'CANCELLED' AND order_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS

benchmarks.question: Top 5 categories by net revenue this month
benchmarks.sql: SELECT category, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue),2) AS net_revenue FROM {catalog}.gold.obt_retail_sales WHERE status <> 'CANCELLED' AND order_date >= date_trunc('month', current_date()) GROUP BY category ORDER BY net_revenue DESC LIMIT 5

benchmarks.question: Which store had the most units sold in the last 30 days?
benchmarks.sql: SELECT store_name, SUM(quantity) AS units FROM {catalog}.gold.obt_retail_sales WHERE status <> 'CANCELLED' AND order_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS GROUP BY store_name ORDER BY units DESC LIMIT 1

benchmarks.question: Return rate by region for the last 30 days
benchmarks.sql: SELECT region, ROUND(SUM(returned_qty)/SUM(quantity),4) AS return_rate FROM {catalog}.gold.obt_retail_sales WHERE order_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 30 DAYS GROUP BY region ORDER BY region

benchmarks.question: Revenue by channel yesterday
benchmarks.sql: SELECT channel, ROUND(SUM(net_revenue),2) AS net_revenue FROM {catalog}.gold.obt_retail_sales WHERE status <> 'CANCELLED' AND order_date = current_date() - INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY channel ORDER BY channel
